# Monthly offer

> Review the ended launch offer and learn about occasional M Plan promotions.

> [!NOTE]
>
> This offer ended on October 14, 2026. M Plan promotions are offered from time to time. See each promotion's announcement for its dates and terms.

During the M Plan launch offer, Go, Explore, and Build subscriptions with monthly billing included 50% off the first month. Subscriptions purchased under this offer renew automatically at the regular price from the second month.

## Offer period

Ended on October 14, 2026.

## Offer rules

The following rules are retained for reference and apply only to the ended launch offer.

* **Eligible tiers**: The offer applied to Go, Explore, and Build with monthly billing. Annual billing was not included.
* **Offer price**: The first month was 50% off the regular monthly price. From the second month, subscriptions renew at the regular price.

| Tier | First-month discount | Regular price |
| :- | :- | :- |
| Go | 50% off | \$22/month |
| Explore | 50% off | \$55/month |
| Build | 50% off | \$132/month |

* **New purchases**: New subscriptions were charged the first-month offer price of the chosen tier.
* **Upgrades**: Upgrades to an M Plan tier with monthly billing during the offer period, including upgrades from Token Plan or to a higher M Plan tier, were charged the first-month offer price of the new tier minus the remaining value of the existing subscription.
* **Renewal**: After the first month, your subscription renews automatically at the regular price of your tier. If you do not want to renew, turn off auto-renewal before the current period ends. See [Upgrades and cancellation](https://platform.minimax.io/docs/m-plan/change-plan.md).
